description:
Restaurants bookable through this network, and what each one's system supports.

        Returns every venue that has opted in, across restaurant groups. Two optional filters
        narrow it, never widen it: `signup_form_id` to one website's venues when you found an
        Orion signup embed on a restaurant's page, and `venue_id` to a single venue when
        you already have its loyalist-venue-id (off a page's markup or a ReserveAction entry
        point) and want just that one rather than listing them all and matching yourself.
        Neither can reach a venue that has not opted in.

        A venue with `bookable: false` has no reservation system connected and will return
        no availability.
name: find_venues
